Name: Mini Obelisk (Alternative Textures version)
Author: tikamin557
Description:
The vanilla obelisk was too tall.

This mod is the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] version of "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11887/]Mini Obelisk[/url][size=4]".[/size]

[color=#ff00ff][size=5]Notes.[/size][/color]
[size=4]The island house, the obelisk for coming back to the farm from the island[/size][size=4], which are present in the CP version, cannot be changed with this mod because AT does not seem to support them at this time.[/size]
[size=4]If you want to match their appearance, please change them in the CP version.[/size]
